name: nested doc comments retain their text
source:
/-- Before `/- outer /- inner -/ end -/`, visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: nested module doc and adjacent declaration doc
source:
/-! Module `/- nested -/`, visible $x$. -/
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: ordinary comments and line comments hide fake docs
source:
/- Ordinary /-- Fake $\notARealMacro$. -/ -/
-- /-- Fake $\notARealMacro$. -/
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: ordinary string contains comment markers
source:
def opener : String := "/- /-- Fake $\\notARealMacro$. -/"
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: escaped quote keeps comment marker inside string
source:
def opener : String := "\" /-- Fake $\\notARealMacro$. -/ /-"
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: escaped backslash does not hide closing quote
source:
def slash : String := "\\"
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: zero hash raw string does not escape its closing quote
source:
def opener : String := r"/- /-- Fake $\notARealMacro$. -/ \"
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: one hash raw string permits ordinary quotes
source:
def opener : String := r#"a quote " /-- Fake $\notARealMacro$. -/ /-"#
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: multiple hash raw string requires all closing hashes
source:
def opener : String := r##"a quote "# /-- Fake $\notARealMacro$. -/ /-"##
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: identifier ending r is not a raw string prefix
source:
def idr (s : String) := s
def opener := idr"\" /-- Fake $\\notARealMacro$. -/"
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1

name: character quote and identifier primes do not start strings
source:
def quote : Char := '"'
def escaped : Char := '\"'
def hex : Char := '\x22'
def unicode : Char := '\u0022'
def x' := 1
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def y := x'

name: prime named function applied to a quote character
source:
def f' (c : Char) := c
def q := f' '"'
/-- Visible $x$. -/
def x := 1
